ai.title: Tips for getting a professional headshot that feels authentic and conveys the image you want
ai.description: Professional headshots are like virtual handshakes: They introduce people to to a vast audience for their ideas as well as potential clients, collaborators or employers. The pictures we use for social media profiles, on business websites or in other career contexts create a first impression. Photographers and hiring experts say it's natural to want to look good in a headshot but conveying the image you want to to project is even more important. A tech entrepreneur might want an image that reflects energy. A financial planner might want to convey trustworthiness. Headshots are getting easier and cheaper to make with artificial intelligence. Some experts caution that AI-generated headshots can look inauthentic and too heavily edited.
ai.title_cn: 获得专业头像、感觉真实并传达您想要的形象的技巧
ai.description_cn: 专业的头像就像虚拟握手：它们向广大观众介绍人们的想法以及潜在的客户、合作者或雇主。我们在社交媒体资料、商业网站或其他职业环境中使用的图片会给人留下第一印象。摄影师和招聘专家表示，想要在头像中看起来漂亮是很自然的，但传达你想要投射的图像更加重要。科技企业家可能想要一个反映能量的形象。财务规划师可能想要传达可信度。使用人工智能制作头像变得越来越容易、越来越便宜。一些专家警告说，人工智能生成的头像可能看起来不真实并且编辑过多。
